about.short: I build intelligent systems, algorithms and infrastructure at the intersection of artificial intelligence, machine learning and computer systems.
about.long: I am an ML / AI Engineer with a strong foundation in algorithms, software engineering and machine learning. My work spans intelligent systems, natural language processing, knowledge graphs and performance-oriented software engineering. At IISc, I worked as a Student Researcher in the SML Lab on machine learning and NLP problems involving Knowledge Graphs and large language models. I have also worked at IBM on routing and chip-design software, applying algorithms, computational geometry and optimization to performance-critical engineering problems.

education.description: Graduate study at IISc with research exposure in machine learning, natural language processing and Knowledge Graph-based systems.

experience.description: Working on software engineering and computational problems involving algorithms, systems and performance-oriented engineering.
Worked on machine learning and natural language processing research involving Knowledge Graphs and intelligent question-answering systems.
Worked on routing quality and chip-design software involving C++ and computational geometry.
Worked in the System Development Lab.

projects.name: Forecasting with Temporal Knowledge Graphs
projects.description: Research project exploring temporal Knowledge Graphs in which event timestamps are associated with entity relationships, enabling reasoning and forecasting over time.

projects.name: Knowledge Graph Reasoning and Knowledge Graph-Based Question Answering
projects.description: Research on using Knowledge Graphs to improve reasoning and question answering with machine learning and large language models.

projects.name: Optimization in Chip Design with Routing Quality Checker
projects.description: Developed an optimized software architecture for a Routing Quality Checker and worked on a Timing-Aware Fixer as part of an IBM internship.

projects.name: Data Analytics Projects
projects.description: Worked on diverse data analytics projects across sports, health, neuroscience, space, social networks and machine learning. Projects included the Duckworth-Lewis-Stern method, effects of smoking, COVID-19 modelling, colour blindness, visual processing, Mars orbit analysis, community detection, hypothesis testing, recommendation systems and NLP.

projects.name: Deep Learning with Natural Language Processing
projects.description: Worked on deep learning and NLP projects including sentiment analysis using LSTM networks on a large-scale review dataset and unified date-format conversion using machine translation with an Encoder-Decoder Attention architecture.

research.title: Free Hand Routing using AI
research.description: Patent work at IBM India addressing automation of complex design workflows using an intelligent vision-based approach to interpret hand-drawn layouts and convert them into structured routing topologies.

certifications.name: Google Cloud Platform Fundamentals: Core Infrastructure

awards.name: First at Robodangal
awards.description: Won a robotics competition held at Aligarh Muslim University.
